Конкретно по поводу Cubicolor:
Изначально мы - Кубик чёрного цвета. Путь на выход уровня как всегда не прост, под ним находятся блоки другого цвета. Нужно "наступать" в плюсы, чтобы окраситься в тот или иной цвет, а затем на блоки этого цвета, чтобы удалить преграду к выходу.
Никакого таймера нет, но дополнительную сложность здесь создают падающие платформы, на которые мы наступаем, то есть вернуться назад или свободно передвигаться не получится - смерть. Почти всегда будем добираться до выхода, обрушивая все платформы. Уровни условно разделены на три категории: Начинающий, Умный и Гений (за прохождение каждого режима - достижение). Серьёзные проблемы могут возникнуть, думаю, только с последним из них.
Правильный угол обзора и приятная музыка как всегда в плюсы игре. Рекомендую, хотя бы по скидке.

短評
『お手軽アンビエントパズル』
・シンプルな一筆書きパズル
・3レベル全48ステージ
・最後の方はちょっとだけ難しい
・アンビエント系BGMが最高に心地よい

本文
　ストアの動画と画像を見れば、どういうゲーム、システムなのか一目瞭然なので割愛。キューブを転がしていく一筆書きパズルだ。レベル、ステージ数も上記の通り。この値段でこの数なら相応か、安いと見ていいだろう。
　そこまで頭のいいわけでもない自分でも2時間で全ステージをクリアできるので、難易度はそこまで高くない（と思う）。解けた後の達成感が強いので疲れを感じず次のステージへ、また次のステージへと進んでしまう。
　グラフィックもさることながら、BGMも無駄が削ぎ落とされたアンビエントで、解法を考える時間もまた癒やしの時間へと変換される。自分のようにガッツリとプレイするのもいいけれど、落ち着いた時間を味わうためにゆっくりと2、3問ずつ解いていくのもいいかもしれない。
　最後に自分が勘違いしていた部分を書いておく。白のタイルを全て踏破する必要はなく、色の付いたタイルを全て踏めばクリア条件を満たしたことになる。また、ゴール地点のタイルの積み上がった順と、実際の踏破順は同じでなくても良く、自分の考えたルートで自由に踏破できる（自由にと言っても解法はおそらく1つだけだけれど…）

Cubicolor is an awesome minimalistic puzzle game, that features 48 different levels and has a really nice piano soundtrack that greatly blends with the general feeling of the game itself.
If you love puzzle/logic games, you'll love this one for sure :)
The game's mechanics are quite simple - you'll have a rectangle-shaped playing board over a plain white background, with colored cubes over it. The white tiles that form the board will feature two kinds of designs - a full colored one (i.e.: a tile completley painted of blue, red, yellow etc.) or a cross-shaped colored tile (of the same colors). Playing as a black cube, you'll be required to step on the colored symbols - they will color your cube entirely of their own color - and, as a now-green, yellow etc. cube, you will have to paint the whole path and reach the exit.
Obviously, there will be a rather nice difficulty progression so that you'll have a board with 2, 3, 4 and so on colored tiles (which are the respective "exits" of the colors) and the same amount of crosses.. so that your goal will be to create paths (of course, upon coloring a tile it will disappear and you can only pass once through a path) that will both connect your colored cube to its corresponding exit and, in the end, reach the black square that will forcibly be the last square you'll have to reach having colored - and thus removed - all the other ones.
Trust me - it's way easier to play it rather than to explain it xD
It's greatly made and everything goes on smooth and fast, it's entertaining, quite long and addictive.. and also quite challenging!!
Too bad that this developer has published only this game :')
So, well, the "genius" series will often feature your final black square over like 8 other colored squares, meaning that you've got to wear a blue suit and go to the blue square - but there will be two for every color! choose wisely xD - and so on with all the other ones. All the colors are bright and anyways with a bit of logic and thinking (you can look up some guide if you really need.. like I did sometimes XD) you'll make it through every level.
Really, this is how a logic/puzzle game should be made :)
The 48 levels will be split into three categories - namely normal, smart and genius levels as I said, but the difficulty progression's great and you can also play casually this game without spending too much time in single sessions.
And the hours you'll spend here - 3 or 4 I think - will be hours of complete relax - no timers, no cooldowns, no bonuses and no distractions, just a soothing piano music and your logic puzzle game :)
Plus, you'll also be able to remap your controls since you'll need to restart quite often late in the game xD
The lack of a button that makes you undo your previous action isn't really a big concern - of course it would have been nice, but the levels run all smoothly and they are never that long so that if you really mess up something, just hit restart and it's ok :)
I really hope that these devs will publish more games in the future, but as of 2018 if you're a fan of logic and puzzle games in general be sure you don't miss this title!

Papier/crayon, j'ai utilisé Gimp, mais c'est pareil :).

[h1]GNU/Linux[/h1]

La version Linux est nickel, à part la gestion de la résolution. Le plein écran en multiscreen est très mal géré : il éteint tous les écrans sauf le principal. Bon, vu le type de jeu, jouer en fenêtré n'est pas vraiment gênant, mais quand on quitte le jeu, il touche à la résolution du multiscreen. Pour ma part, il mettait l'écran de gauche dans un combo résolution/rafraichissement pas supporté, il fallait le rerégler. Bref, pas au point de ce côté...

OS: Linux Mint 18.2 x64, MATE edition.
Hardware : i7 7700K OC@5Ghz, Nvidia 1080GTX, 32GB ram.
Screens : Triplescreen, dont un vertical, un seul screen X.
A short little mind bender, Cubicolor is worth the 2 dollars for a fun, medium hard puzzle game.
